dotsVerdict.why: t26's own path never decodes dots. The chunk normalises a flat array into one chain and passes it verbatim to eda.sch_PrimitiveWire.create(line, net) (build.ts L479-490), and create() expects exactly the Line format. On top of that the dedupe key is net + '|' + JSON.stringify(line) against the page's own getState_Line(), so it always hits and create() is never called. But the IR contract for dots is a polyline: readback.ts L253-255 and serialize.ts L311-315 step i += 2 and take four numbers per segment, which is correct for a shared-vertex polyline and wrong for a Line with disjoint segments. So the fixture is a type lie with a dormant failure mode

evidence.case1_t26Shape: page holds the same net|line, replay dots = that 8-number Line -> status OK, created 1, failures [], createCalls 0 (dedupe short-circuits; no geometry is read)
evidence.case2_dedupeMiss: page holds a different line -> create() receives the 8-number array verbatim, length 8, net A (the chunk forwards Line format; a created wire would not be corrupted)
evidence.case3_lineIntoIr: the same array as IR dots -> serializeEasyEdaDocument emits 3 LINE records, 1 diagonal: (40,-805)->(10,-775), i.e. the fake connector p1->p2 (42.43 long). For the 20-number +3V3 line the same arithmetic gives 9 records and 4 diagonals
evidence.case4_control: a real polyline [10,20,40,20,40,50] -> 2 LINE records, 0 diagonals, proving the IR path is right for what it is documented to accept

dotsVerdict.consequence: t26 cannot report a wrong line: its assertion only checks status/created===1/failures and the dedupe key is built from the same array, so a diagonal in the fixture is invisible. Do not reuse t26's object shape as a dots fixture, and do not feed a Line into IR dots (serialize/readback) — that path does manufacture diagonals
dotsVerdict.secondInconsistency: the chunk (build.ts L486-490) forwards each dots chain to create() as if it were a Line, while serialize/readback treat the same chain as a polyline. The two agree only for single-segment chains (4 numbers), which is what every current IR row appears to use; a bent 6-number chain would reach create() as vertices. Not exercised by t26, recorded as a latent boundary
